The graph's high homophily (0.497) and feature dimension (25) support local_affinity (neighbor similarity) and homophily_violation (feature-neighbor mismatch). attr_struct_mismatch (divergence between attribute/structure rankings) is enabled by feature_dim >=2. Spectral analysis (high-frequency signals) is viable due to num_nodes >=30. These paradigms target distinct aspects: structural-attribute divergence, local feature agreement, homophily deviations, and spectral anomalies, ensuring complementary coverage.
